roles.title: Software Developer
roles.summary: Web apps for the company, and monitoring and automation for its connectivity and election projects with DepEd and COMELEC.
highlights: Building the iOne Helpdesk (client and staff portals, SLA tracking, escalation, audit logging) and the new company website.
Built live dashboards and a real-time monitoring system for the LeoXSolar satellite internet rollout across 3,000+ DepEd school sites, with Google Apps Script keeping site data current.
Built network monitoring on the Omada API that tracks device status and data use per site, in support of the project's SLA.
Configured and checked election transmission devices for the 2025 national and 2026 BARMM elections, with standby support during field testing and mock elections.
Wrote a Selenium tool that configures election transmission devices, cutting setup from 10 to 5 minutes per device and reducing manual errors.

roles.title: Network Operations and Software Developer Intern
roles.summary: Configured and deployed Teltonika routers for nationwide connectivity during the 2025 COMELEC elections, and handled firmware updates, configuration backups and inventory for a fleet of 2,000+ routers.
highlights: Built a web automation tool and scripts with PRTG and XPath to speed up router setup, and trained fellow interns to use it.

roles.title: Software Research and Development Intern
roles.summary: Designed Figma wireframes for a point-of-sale system (inventory, sales tracking and payments), revised them with the developers as they built the features, and tested web and mobile apps before release.
